Trace, implement and test: Hash Map

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
var HashMap = Java.type("java.util.HashMap");
var hm = new HashMap();
hm.put("India", "New Delhi");
hm.put("Japan", "Tokyo");
hm.put("Germany", "Berlin");
hm.put("Russia", "Moscow");
hm.put("USA", "Washington DC");

for each (var i in hm.keySet()) print(i+ " : " + hm[i]);
